status_note: Parametric build from scratch (D-06, 04 §3.10); no Tripo, no source mesh. Every number here is a proposal for the fallback figure, not a budget and not an art decision.

reference_image.role: shape reference only: segmented grey figure, blank oval head, fists at the hips, dark round base with a light side band

skeletal.why: task of 2026-09-28: humanoid on UM_HUMANOID_17_v1 (rig contract); a fallback that can take shared clips once a common UE Skeleton is proven (RIG-CONTRACT §8, open). Deviates from the 04 card, both variants are delivered and the choice stays open

scale.choice_note: 50 uu from the base bottom to the top of the head = ART-001 test figure «50 uu ±2» (04 §2 / QA-009) and inside the hero range 45-55 uu (04 §3); 04 §3.10 «капсульная фигура 48 uu + голова» is read as «about 48-50 uu with the head», AD-CNF (17 line 2162) open. Head 8.8 cm of a 46 cm figure = 5.2 heads (03 С-1: 5-6).

base.team_note: team colour on the side band (2.0 uu) and on the top chamfer (Ø24 -> Ø21.2, seen from the -55 deg camera); first build had only a 1.4 uu side band, ≈ 2 px at K-1 (preview game_k1_3q, 2026-09-28). Dark rims keep the reference look (dark base, light band)
base.footprint_note: Ø24 x 4 uu: between Base_Sidekick Ø22 x 5 and Base_Hero Ø30 x 6 (04 §3.8); the ART-001 figure used Ø24. Fits a 100 uu cell with the Ø40 selection ring of ASSET-MARKERS-001 around it.

channels.R: team band on the base side and the top chamfer of the base (TeamColor; 03 С-11: team colour only on bases/rings/markers)
channels.G: 0 (reserved: centre instance pip in the Harpy base convention)
channels.B: 0 (reserved: outer instance pips in the Harpy base convention)

mask.note: Binary 0/1 values. The figure carries the attribute with R=G=B=0 on purpose: a mesh without vertex colours reads as white (1,1,1,1) in UE and a mask material would paint it in the team colour.

base.name: M_PlaceholderMannequin_Base
base.team_colors_note: 03 С-11 hex converted sRGB -> linear (#E8C06A, #9FC2D8), same values as the Harpy profile

collision.note: Covers the base rim (0.12, 0, 0.04) and the top of the head (z 0.50); the lower hemisphere reaches z -0.09, under the board plane (selection only, 04 §1 «Коллизии»).

armature.weapon_note: Unweighted leaf under hand.L = the machine-readable default of rig-contract.json (bones[16].parent); Arthur/Merlin use hand.R (RIG-CONTRACT §11 q.2 open). The mannequin carries no weapon.

weights.method: rigid: every part 100 % on one bone (segmented artist mannequin); ball-like capsule ends are centred on the joints, so a rotation about the joint keeps the gap covered

parts_note: loft rings: [t along a->b (may be <0 or >1 for caps), radius along u, radius along v, world offset x, y, z]; radius 0 = pole vertex. u = world X projected off the axis (or world Y for axes near X), v = axis x u. Mirrored (.R) parts: x of a, b and offsets negated.
foot_note: octagon rings are turned by 180/sides deg so flat faces look front/side/down; the sole face of every foot ring is at centre_z + off_z - r_v*cos(22.5 deg) = 0.0390-0.0394 m, i.e. 0.6-1.0 mm inside the base top (no floating, no coplanar faces)

uv.method: Smart UV Project per mesh (angle 66 deg, island margin 0.02), UV0 only
uv.note: 04 §3.10: no textures. UV0 exists so that M_DioramaMaster (texture parameters) and a later AO bake work; measured at 1K (04 §1: 1K for helpers and small items).

game_camera.k1_note: cell 1 m ≈ 250 px at 1920 px width (04 §3, proposal): 2·D·tan(17.5°) = 7.68 m -> D = 12.18 m
